description: This file defines the EncryptedSerializable class, which wraps another Serializable object and encrypts its data using TPM resources to ensure privacy. It includes methods for serialization, deserialization, and size calculation, and references TPM resource management and keymaster serialization.

classes.name: EncryptedSerializable
classes.description: A class that encrypts and decrypts data of another Serializable object using TPM resources, ensuring data privacy within secure environments.

methods.name: EncryptedSerializable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EncryptedSerializable with TPM resource manager, a function to obtain TPM object slots, and the Serializable object to wrap.

methods.name: SerializedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the serialized encrypted data.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the wrapped Serializable object into a buffer, encrypting the data with TPM.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer, decrypting it and reconstructing the wrapped Serializable object.
